title: Bright logo sting
prompt:
Make a 2.5 s logo sting sound effect for video at 30 fps.
Output: one WAV, 48 kHz / 16-bit / stereo, exactly 120000 samples.
Python + numpy/scipy only. Synthesise everything (no samples, no downloads). Fixed random seed.
Sound: major chord bloom + shimmer tail; logo at 0, sparkle at frame 60.
Master: −14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
Verify length, loudness, peak with ffmpeg ebur128; render spectrogram; fix until checks pass.
notes: Runner-verified local numpy/scipy synthesis. Mastering: pyloudnorm stereo LUFS + true-peak limit (ffmpeg ebur128 verification).
